name: Csernely (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of yellow, dark green and yellow in the ratio 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Csernely: a light blue shield with two white towers and the year 1236, within a yellow wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
